```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
cereal <-read_excel("cereal.xlsx")
head(cereal) 
```


#### Q1. Extract rows 1 to 10 from the cereal data frame.

```{r}
subset_cereal <- cereal[1:10, ]
subset_cereal
```

#### Q2. Create a new data frame called Kelloggs that only contains rows where company == “K”.

```{r}
Kelloggs <- subset(cereal,company =="K")
Kelloggs
```

#### Q3.From the cereal data, extract the names of all cereals that have more than 10 grams of sugar. 

```{r}
sugar<- cereal$name[cereal$sugars > 10]
sugar
```

#### Q4.Find the mean calories of all cereals in the dataset.
```{r}
mean(cereal$calories)
```

#### Q5. Count how many cereals have fiber greater than or equal to 2 grams

```{r}
length(cereal$fiber[cereal$fiber>=2])
```
